note: Alan's action sprites, proposed 2026-10-31 (docs/review/action_sprites.md); not run yet: python3 scripts/ludo.py batch scripts/ludo_runs_alan_actions.json --budget <n>. Existing and reusable: alanv_phone, alanv_drink, alanv_write.

runs.name: alanv_pickup
runs.prompt: bends his knees and crouches, picks up something small from the floor in front of him with his right hand, looks at it, and stands up again holding it; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Wed boots, Sun packing, Sun the discs, Mon the fuse and the keys; with the water up to the shins it also reads as setting a disc

runs.name: alanv_setdown
runs.prompt: crouches and sets something small down carefully on the floor in front of him with his right hand, presses it into place, and stands up again; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Mon: each disc into its socket, in the water

runs.name: alanv_reach
runs.prompt: reaches forward at chest height with his right hand, takes something small from someone, and brings his hand back to his side; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Sun the watch, the ticket back from the clerk, Mon Lorenzo's trowel; Sat salt from the footprint

runs.name: alanv_reachup
runs.prompt: reaches up above his head with his right hand, takes hold of something small up there, and brings it down to his chest; his hand stays in the picture the whole time; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Wed the hand on the bell, Mon the crescent from Baute above

runs.name: alanv_read
runs.prompt: holds a few loose sheets of paper in both hands in front of his chest and reads them, turns a page, then lowers them; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Wed the crate labels; Sun Elena's notebook

runs.name: alanv_stretch
runs.prompt: just woken up: stretches both arms up above his head with a big yawn, rolls his shoulders, and lowers his arms; his hands stay in the picture; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn

runs.name: alanv_crank
runs.prompt: turns a heavy crank handle at waist height in front of him with both hands, round and round, leaning his weight into it; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Wed the clock drum in the belfry (instead of the chain pull)

runs.name: alanv_rub
runs.prompt: holds a sheet of paper flat against a surface in front of him at head height with his left hand and rubs a pencil back and forth across it with his right hand; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Wed the inscription rubbing on the bell

runs.name: alanv_heave
runs.prompt: grips a heavy bar at waist height in front of him with both hands, leans back and heaves with his whole weight, straining, then lets go; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Sun the vault grille, with Yeray and with Carmen

runs.name: alanb_phone
runs.prompt: lifts an old telephone receiver to his ear with his right hand, listens and talks, then lowers it again
runs.use: Tue evening's call, in the blazer

runs.name: alanb_read
runs.prompt: holds a thin file of papers in both hands in front of his chest and leafs through it, then lowers it; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Thu the Montesdeoca file in Baute's drawer

runs.name: alanb_reachup
runs.prompt: reaches up above his head with his right hand towards something pinned on a wall, and freezes there; his hand stays in the picture; only him in the picture, no objects or furniture drawn
runs.use: Thu the map on its pins, just before the light comes on
